test_title: PYST 63: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 07 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: A teacher makes 10 kindergarten children sit in two parallel rows, such that five children are sitting in each row facing each other. Anu, Bobby, Lilly, Tom and Sudha sitting in Row 1 face north, while children Priya, Rama, Uma, Kala and Guna in Row 2 face the south direction. Lilly is facing the immediate neighbour of Guna. Tom sits third to the left of Sudha. Anu does not sit at the corners. Neither Priya nor Rama sits at the corner. Guna sits in the middle of the line. Only one child sits between Lilly and Tom. Kala sits at one of the corners but not facing Sudha. Priya sits to the right of Rama but not immediate. Which child is facing Tom?
solution:
The sitting arrangement as per the given information:

**Given information:**

Row **1**: → Anu, Bobby, Lilly, Tom and Sudha (Facing north)

Row **2**: → Priya, Rama, Uma, Kala and Guna (Facing south)

1. Tom sits third to the left of Sudha and only one child sits between Lilly and Tom.

**Case 1:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9142b88b6d8890ad6c5b10ff68767fa147680a7d5e35be39b1311d125916e6e.png] 

**Case 2:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94b8c5c93dda6ff0afc13975fbfa9aa754f7fdfa2eb6f302e1f5ddaa73e79f7f.png] 

2. Guna sits in the middle of the line and Lilly is facing the immediate neighbour of Guna.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7fdf5e41fccbaecdbfc7d152efbf2637fb77756b3634fb9b6b4cc315a1265e1f.png] 

3. Kala sits at one of the corners but not facing Sudha and Anu does not sit at the corners.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e9fa451d29f23b3148f6226917410535d68409cc4854626caa24a05d4352cf4.png] 

4. Neither Priya nor Rama sits at the corner and Priya sits to the right of Rama but not immediately.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91db29aeedfcc0c9608e71ce3fa8db0a0f3ec400de2d1dae9a26f17628698c79.png] 

Here, **'Priya'** is facing Tom.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".
